description: (needs account token) Switches a site's statistics between standard (cookieless, no banner, the default) and enhanced (adds a cookie consent banner for every visitor, and the click heatmap). Enhanced changes what visitors see. confirm=true applies enhanced. Does not charge.

confirm.description: True applies enhanced statistics. False leaves the level unchanged and the reply describes the change.

site.description: The address of a site on this account, for example myproject.dropthehassle.app.

name: set_analytics_level
title: Set analytics level
